# Beagle v0.25.0

Beagle v0.25.0 is the final release of Beagle's file-authored, typed-Lisp
language line. It seals the Clojure-derived compiler and its Store, Native Core,
hosted-target, provenance, and materialization infrastructure before native
proposition-first work begins. This is not a proposition-first release.

## Final typed-Lisp line

- Source files and the checked typed-Lisp program remain the authority for
  native program meaning in this release. The compiler follows its established
  parse, check, and emit or Native Core lowering paths.
- The existing `.bgl`, `.bclj`, `.bjs`, and `.bnix` authoring profiles remain
  available as frozen migration surfaces. No relational solver, checked theory,
  oriented-plan protocol, or proposition-first default is included.

## Migration boundary

- Pin `v0.25.0` when a program must retain the typed-Lisp and file-authority
  contract. Later native Beagle development moves program authority into sealed
  semantic models instead of preserving this line through compatibility code.
- Beagle Store, provenance, incremental computation, effects, observations,
  and target materialization remain part of the system carried by this release;
  the boundary freezes the authoring and program-authority model, not those
  reusable system capabilities.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tompassarelli/beagle/compare/v0.24.0...v0.25.0
